name: HEKTAR
recent: Hektar REIT 将一项关联方收购与租赁的合约条件期限延长六个月至2027年5月23日，同时另一项非关联方收购因卖方未满足先决条件而终止。公司2026年第三季度营收同比小幅增长3.2%，但净利润同比下降14.5%。此外，大股东UPAYAPADU系公司近期多次申报股权变动。
notable: 将关联方收购与租赁的合约条件期限延长六个月至2027年5月23日。
终止一项非关联方收购，因卖方未满足若干关键先决条件，定金将退还。
2026年第三季度营收同比增长3.2%至3204万林吉特。
risks: 2026年第三季度净利润同比下降14.5%，净利率从19.5%降至10.8%。
大股东UPAYAPADU系公司近期多次申报股权变动。
有媒体报道公司资产可能被出售。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收3204万林吉特，同比增长3.2%，环比增长0.4%；净利润345万林吉特，同比下降14.5%，环比下降44.6%；净利率10.8%，低于上一季度的19.5%。

recent_en: Hektar REIT extended the conditional period for a related-party acquisition and lease by six months to 23 May 2027, while a separate non-related-party acquisition was terminated after the vendor failed to fulfil conditions precedent. Revenue for 3Q 2026 rose 3.2% year-on-year, but net income fell 14.5%. Substantial shareholder UPAYAPADU entities have also made multiple filings on changes in their interests recently.
notable_en: Extended the conditional period for the related-party acquisition and lease by six months to 23 May 2027.
Terminated a non-related-party acquisition after the vendor failed to fulfil several key conditions precedent; the deposit will be refunded.
3Q 2026 revenue rose 3.2% year-on-year to MYR32.0 million.
risks_en: 3Q 2026 net income fell 14.5% year-on-year, with net margin dropping from 19.5% to 10.8%.
Substantial shareholder UPAYAPADU entities have made multiple filings on changes in their interests recently.
Media reported that the company's assets may be up for sale.
earnings_en: 3Q 2026 revenue was MYR32.0 million, up 3.2% year-on-year and 0.4% quarter-on-quarter; net income was MYR3.45 million, down 14.5% year-on-year and 44.6% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 10.8%, down from 19.5% in the previous quarter.
